items.question: What equal quantity of cow dung, milk, and curd is prescribed in this rite?
premises: Cow dung is measured as half a pala.
Milk is measured as one prastha.
Curd is prescribed in equal measure.
items.inference: The verse prescribes half a pala of cow dung, a prastha of milk, and an equal amount of curd.
uncertainties: The exact ritual application is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Half a pala of cow dung, a prastha of milk, and an equal amount of curd.
